name: lifetracker
description: lifetracker is a real-time personal growth platform built with a React-only frontend, Node.js services, Redis, Kafka, Lambda, Docker, and CI/CD.

scripts.build: npm run prepare:packages && npm run build --workspaces --if-present
scripts.check: npm run prepare:packages && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test
scripts.prepare:packages: npm run build --workspace @lifetracker/ui && npm run build --workspace @lifetracker/shared && npm run build --workspace @lifetracker/database && npm run build --workspace @lifetracker/backend-common
